security_and_recovery.catalog_scope: The real local composed test uses the actual SQLite catalog and HTTP server to create and replace governed assets, publish sensitivity/ownership, follow a bounded cursor, search, read revisions, traverse lineage, observe a separate workspace without leakage, reopen the server and verify persistence, and reject catalog mutation with workspace.read-only permissions.
security_and_recovery.project_scope: CatalogAsset carries optional project_id metadata, but the public catalog API and authorizer are workspace-scoped and expose no separate project_id filter or project-level authorization requirement. This is recorded as an open P6 limitation, not inferred as project isolation.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: RONIN_POSTGRES_TEST_DSN is absent and Docker does not provide a responsive daemon. No PostgreSQL operator, Docker worker or external provider was certified, and no mock was substituted.

Static checks generated .mypy_cache/.ruff_cache after the first exact run; cleanup/regeneration removed them before final verify and the scans were repeated on the clean manifest-bound sandbox.
